title: a subagent-tier build needs no launch-only field: it is valid with only id, version, status, tier, description, prompt, model, effort and tools, and a worker can launch with it
source: intended: docs/decisions.md (tier matrix: route_scope, budget, mode_default, agents_md and harness are optional in a subagent-tier build)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-11, tier fields; docs/decisions.md). A subagent-tier build never launches alone, so route_scope, budget, mode_default, agents_md and harness mean nothing to it: they are optional and unused. The overlay jitso/builds/lean.yaml has only id, version, status, tier, description, prompt, model, effort and tools, and jitso/builds/lean-team.yaml is a worker that lists it. The catalog is valid: `build list` exits 0 and lists lean-team and not lean (a subagent is never listed), a dry launch of lean-team exits 0, and a real launch hands claude an --agents entry whose description and prompt are the file's text as written.

files.jitso/builds/lean.yaml:
id: lean
version: 1
status: approved
tier: subagent
description: Lean helper used by a contract case, it carries only what claude needs.
prompt: You are the lean helper of this session. Answer in one line and never edit a file.
model: claude-haiku-5-5
effort: low
tools: [Read, Glob, Grep]
files.jitso/builds/lean-team.yaml:
id: lean-team
version: 1
status: approved
role: operator
type: explorer
work_kind: repo-exploration
description: Worker used by a contract case, it lists a lean subagent.
harness: claude
model: claude-haiku-5-5
effort: low
mode_default: direct
agents_md: exclude
route_scope: [none]
skills_first: []
tools: [Read, Glob, Grep, Bash]
subagents: [lean]
mcp: []
requires: []
budget: { tokens: 250000, usd_list_cap: 0.50 }

--agents.equals: Lean helper used by a contract case, it carries only what claude needs.
You are the lean helper of this session. Answer in one line and never edit a file.
